style_references.role: Detailed shaded pixel-art anatomy, clothing and silhouette; identity not copied
Richly illustrated horizontal cinematic panels, lighting and texture

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished bitmap cinematic atlas for a retro action web game.
Input images: Image 1 (journey-cinema-canonical.png) is the main STYLE and three-horizontal-panels layout reference from the user's Omacontra project. Image 2 (dhh-body-canonical.png) is supporting reference for detailed shaded pixel-art anatomy, tactile clothing and metal. Do NOT copy its identity, beard, skull shirt or any logos.
Create a new original atlas, 1536x1024, EXACTLY THREE edge-to-edge equally tall ultra-wide cinematic strips stacked vertically, hard straight dividers at y=341 and y=683. Each row is one contiguous shot, no subpanels or text. All three shots feature the SAME Rambo-like veteran action hero: muscular adult man with rugged natural face, clean-shaven, long dark brown tousled hair, red cloth headband with two loose ends, sleeveless dark olive open combat vest over bare chest, ammunition belt, olive cargo pants. Anatomically convincing, serious grounded face, not anime or angular cartoon.
Match the richly shaded high-fidelity arcade pixel illustration of Omacontra: believable anatomy, dark outlines, hand-clustered pixel texture, subtle highlights, warm skin, cold green rim light, cinematic depth. No flat polygon art, no big square caricature eyes, no plastic 3D, no smooth vector art.
Setting: night-black green digital sky with restrained falling code far in background and a dark helicopter skid or rigging visible to establish that he is suspended beneath it. Dramatic cool green bounce and warm amber edge light. Avoid filling every inch with sparks.
TOP STRIP: intimate three-quarter bust close-up of the hero tying the red headband behind his head, elbows raised and two anatomically correct hands at the knot. Hero face just right of center looking intensely down/right; two distinct red fabric tails fly toward the LEFT in rotor wind. Hair has fine individual pixel clusters. Face and bandana are the dominant focus. It should look like a detailed vintage action-game cinematic portrait.
MIDDLE STRIP: a cinematic close-up of his muscular forearms and TWO correctly posed hands pulling an oversized belt-fed M60-style machine gun from its sling and racking it. The long dark gun extends RIGHT, readable barrel, receiver, cooling slots, stock, ammo belt with brass rounds. One hand grips pistol grip, the other racking bolt. Red bandana and partial face at upper left connect identity, no stray fingers or disembodied extra hands.
BOTTOM STRIP: medium-wide hero shot, visible from head to knees, suspended beneath a helicopter skid by a dark harness strap. Same hero holding the same big machine gun with BOTH hands in a natural supported grip, aiming diagonally DOWN and RIGHT around 40 degrees. Two red bandana tails streaming LEFT. Gun muzzle at around 75% across and 75% down THIS strip. No muzzle flash in base artwork: game code will animate flash and bullets. Character occupies center-right with atmospheric negative space on left. Detailed shading comparable to the reference.
NO words, titles, captions, logos, watermark, Omarchy branding, borders around individual subjects. Deliver a complete professional cinematic illustration atlas, not a mockup of a screen.
assets.edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: supplied 1536x1024 three-panel cinematic atlas. Preserve EXACT canvas size, all three panel boundaries, faces, hands, hair, bodies, guns, lighting, colors and detailed pixel artwork.
ONLY remove the FREE-FLYING loose red fabric tails of the bandana in each of the three panels, replacing the removed cloth with the naturally continuing background behind it. Keep the red forehead band and tiny tied knot at the back of the head unchanged. Keep all red bandana cloth tightly wrapped around the head and the cloth being directly gripped by the top-panel hand.
Top row: remove free ribbon tails that extend LEFT of the left raised hand (roughly x=220..585, y=65..222); retain the hand and headband.
Middle row: remove free ribbon tails flying left of the hair (roughly x=0..210,y=348..505); preserve hair silhouette and forehead band.
Bottom row: remove free ribbon tails extending left from the back of head (roughly x=585..730,y=695..751); retain tiny knot at x=735,y=716 and band.
This is preparation for separately animated ribbon sprites: do not add replacement ribbons, new characters, text, marks, borders, glow or changes to the composition. The rest of the image must remain visually identical.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent-background modular gameplay sprite atlas, 1536x1024.
Input images: Image 1 (dhh-body-canonical.png) is STYLE reference from user's Omacontra game: richly shaded arcade pixel art, believable muscular anatomy, crisp silhouettes, detailed cloth. Image 2 (journey-cinema-canonical.png) is supporting lighting/detail reference. Do NOT copy any beard, skull-shirt, logos, identity or background.
Create a new original Rambo-style small-game character with long dark brown windblown hair, clean-shaven rugged adult face, red headband, open dark olive sleeveless vest, bare muscular arms/chest, brass ammo belt, olive cargo trousers and dark combat boots. Natural proportion, head not enlarged. Detailed 16-bit/32-bit arcade PIXEL ART with carefully clustered highlights, no flat polygons, no vector art, no smooth 3D. The eventual gameplay body is only 32 pixels tall, so prioritize muscular silhouette and readable contrast.
EXACT 3-column by 2-row atlas of six separate 512x512 cells on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, no floor, shadow, halo, text or grid.
Cell TOP LEFT: complete head-to-boots body of this hero dangling from a helicopter, facing RIGHT, 3/4 profile, subtle forward lean, bent relaxed knees/feet hanging down. Body centered x=200 within cell, head top y=40 boots bottom y=460. BOTH upper arms visible but NO forearms/hands and NO gun: forearms with weapon will be a separate attachable layer. Upper arms end cleanly near elbow y=200. Red headband wraps forehead at y=95, NO loose tails in this body layer (tails separate). Narrow harness straps attached at shoulders rise toward top of cell. Preserve complete clothing, torso and legs.
Cell TOP MIDDLE: same exact body, same anchor and anatomy/scale, second hanging pose with boots a few pixels apart and subtle knee bend, head stays same place. NO forearms/hands/gun and NO bandana tails.
Cell TOP RIGHT: isolated weapon WITH BOTH bare forearms and hands holding it correctly, M60-style belt-fed machine gun, pointed exactly horizontally RIGHT. Long receiver, cooling slots, stock, trigger grip, underbarrel support hand, brass ammo belt. All fits inside cell with 30px transparent border. Forearms on LEFT extend toward gun, shoulder attachment point around x=70,y=240, muzzle around x=460,y=240. Gun artwork height around 150px, forearms below. All components naturally connected; no extra fingers.
Cell BOTTOM LEFT: isolated TWO red cloth bandana tails sharing a single tied knot on RIGHT at x=450,y=230, streaming LEFT to x=55 as two visually separate ribbons, one above and one below, with natural sinusoidal wind curves, tapered ends, cloth creases, red highlights and dark red shadows. No head/body.
Cell BOTTOM MIDDLE: same two cloth tails, exact knot anchor and scale, next wind frame curves changed.
Cell BOTTOM RIGHT: same two cloth tails, exact knot anchor and scale, third wind frame curves changed.
Maintain consistent realistic arcade sprite anatomy and warm skin/olive/red palette in all body and arm sprites. Transparent spacing between cells. Fully colored pixel-art game assets, not sketches.

runtime: Source crops and anchors in src/action-assets.js. Atlas alpha preserved. Gameplay body downsampled to 32 logical pixels, suspended on a six-pixel harness. Gun pose shares barrel geometry with simulation. Three separate cloth frames animate both red tails in gameplay and cinema. Local generated paths are provenance only.
